snippet.title: Flick Shot Rogues - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Plan, Aim, Shoot! Here's your look at gameplay and more from Flick Shot Rogues in this trailer for the upcoming roguelite, turn-based strategy game. In Flick Shot Rogues, chain together ridiculous combos, unlock characters with unique abilities, items and skills, and conquer the island. Flick Shot Rogues will be available on PC with a demo available now on Steam.
